content: Require asynchronous signature verification DcmDspAuthenticationVerifyProofOfOwnerShipClientJobRef is only valid if the referenced CsmJob itself: • has a CsmProcessingMode set to CRYPTO_PROCESSING_ASYNC • references a CsmPrimitive with an aggregated CsmSignatureVerify.
